# War-transition fixture

`war-i-end.json` is the saved first-War terminal position from the 2026-10-10
grand-campaign playtest evidence (`grand-campaign/war-i-end.json`). Its 449 old
history entries are omitted to keep this transition-only fixture small. The
board, RNG, victory and succession bookkeeping are unchanged. It is not a new
playthrough and is not used as evidence for current card-draw correctness.
The helper transition result is compared with direct execution by the current
engine. The existing `grand_campaign_2026_10/war-iiy-end.json` supplies the
second-to-third War boundary.
